guidance: We expect quarterly revenues to cross INR100 crores in Q3 of the current year, and we are on track of mission INR500 crores by 2028.

capex: Number three, very interestingly it provided a geographical expansion opportunity outside the 6 states where Group Pharma does not exist today in these businesses, these brands.
So I think this was more of expansion opportunity for us in terms of these 2 brands getting scaled up.
risks: Currently, we are a singular market company that has its strengths and that also has its own challenges.
It had its own challenges because it has been a legacy brand, very old molecule.
focus: But other businesses, other vertical therapies, we don't have any plans of any new product launches in quarter 3.

Currently, we are 100% focused on what is visible for us, relatively much closer to us, which is 2028 calendar year, Sajal, for hitting that INR500 crores and purely organically, no inorganic play within this.
My second question is more on -- so if you look at the IPM growth, seems like a bulk of the growth is also coming from, let's say, new product introductions into the market.
